correctness.rationale: For each edge ij, closed sum W-s_i-s_j+2f_ij gives, after summing, W>=2 and (n-3)W-(n-4)s_i>=n-1. W=2 would force every integer s_i<=0 but their sum 2W=4; hence W>=3. Constructions give odd 3/even 4. Row sums and every cross -1 defender verified symbolically; direct standalone computations checked every edge for 12<=n<=20 and identities through 40. No infinite proof rests on finite tests.

value.rationale: Closing the published 2..3 odd bound exactly and sharpening 2..5 even to 3..4 for an infinite classical Kneser family resolves one parity and nearly determines the other.
